date.description: Focused date (drives which range is visible).

today.description: Locale/timezone-aware "today" date — useful for highlighting current day.

visibleRange.description: Raw start/end of the currently visible range.

visibleRangeText.description: Localized text for the visible range — prefer this over formatting by hand.

visibleDays.description:
Enumerated dates from visibleRange.start to visibleRange.end, inclusive.
When `workWeekOnly` is true and `view === "week"`, this is filtered down
to `workWeekDays`.

formatDuration.description: Human-friendly duration between two dates, e.g. "1h 30m" / "45m".

formatWeekDay.description: Locale/timezone-aware weekday label for a specific date.

hourRange.description: Hour range shown in day/week time grids (honors dayStartHour/dayEndHour).

events.description: All events (recurring instances expanded against the visible range).

visibleEvents.description: Events whose range overlaps `visibleRange` — the set you actually render.

getAgendaGroups.description:
Visible events grouped by day and sorted by start. Lazy — computed only
when called. Use for agenda / list layouts.

isDragging.description: Whether the user is currently dragging an event.

isSelectingSlot.description: Whether the user is currently selecting a slot.

isResizing.description: Whether the user is currently resizing an event.

dragState.description:
State of the active drag or resize — null when idle. `start`/`end` track the
current pointer-predicted position; `origin` is where the gesture began.

selectedSlot.description: Slot the user selected (clicked or drag-selected). Clears on escape or new click.

focusedDate.description:
Day cell that currently has keyboard focus in a month/year grid. Drives the
roving tabindex emitted by `getDayCellTriggerProps`. `null` when focus
hasn't entered the grid yet — the cell matching `api.date` receives
`tabIndex=0` in that case.

setFocusedDate.description:
Imperatively move keyboard focus to a specific date. Use this to jump
focus from outside the grid (e.g. a "Today" button).

clearFocusedDate.description: Clear keyboard focus. Typically called on grid blur or Escape.

clearSelectedSlot.description: Dismiss the selected slot highlight (e.g. when a create dialog closes).

getEventState.description: Get the state of the event.

getDayColumnState.description:
Day-level flags for the given column — use to conditionally render custom
UI (drop-target hint, day-specific styling) without reconstructing the
comparisons from `dragState` / `selectedSlot`.

getEventPosition.description: Numeric position within a day column — use for custom layouts.

getTimePercent.description: 0..1 fraction of the visible day range corresponding to the given date's time-of-day.

getMonthName.description: Localized full month name for the given date, e.g. "April".

monthNames.description: Twelve localized month names in order.

getMonthGrid.description:
Weeks × days covering the month that contains `date`, padded to full weeks.
Use for month grids and mini-month cells.

getEventById.description: O(1) event lookup by id (reads from the current events list).

getEventsForDay.description: Get events for a given day.

getEventsForSlot.description: Get events for a given slot.

hasConflict.description: Whether the event has a conflict.

getEventEl.description:
The DOM element rendered by `getEventProps` for the given event id.
Useful for anchoring a popover/menu to a specific event from outside
React render cycles. Returns `null` if not yet mounted.

getSelectedSlotEl.description:
The DOM element rendered by `getSelectedSlotProps` for the active
`selectedSlot` day. Useful for anchoring a popover to the selection
(e.g. click-to-create). Returns `null` when nothing is selected.

getRootState.description: Returns the state of the root

onViewChange.description: Fires when the view mode changes.

onDateChange.description: Fires when the focused date changes.

events.description: Flat list of events (expand recurring events before passing)

dayStartHour.description: First hour shown in day/week time grid.

dayEndHour.description: Last hour shown in day/week time grid.

workWeekDays.description: Days of week to show in work-week mode, 0=Sun…6=Sat.

workWeekOnly.description: When true, `api.visibleDays` in week view is filtered down to `workWeekDays`.

onSlotSelect.description:
Fires when a user selects an empty slot — either by single click or by
drag-release. Discriminate via `details.action`. Use to open a quick-create
popover anchored to `selectedSlot`.

onSlotDoubleClick.description:
Fires on double-click of an empty slot — the conventional "create event"
fast-path that bypasses slot selection (selectedSlot is not set).

onDayActivate.description:
Fires when a day cell is activated via click, Enter, or Space while focused.
Typically used in month or year views to navigate to that day's detail view
or open a quick-add dialog.

onEventClick.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

onEventDrop.description: Fires when an event is dropped.

onEventResize.description: Fires when an event is resized.

canDragEvent.description: Return false to prevent dragging an event. Gates entry to event-dragging state.

canResizeEvent.description: Return false to prevent resizing an event. Gates entry to event-resizing state.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale used for week-start day and date formatting.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone string. Defaults to local timezone.

startOfWeek.description: Override the first day of the week (0=Sun…6=Sat). Falls back to locale default.

showWeekNumbers.description: Show week numbers in week view.

showCurrentTime.description: Show a line at the current time in day/week views.

maxRecurrenceInstances.description: Upper bound on expanded recurring instances per visible range.

expandRecurrence.description: Called on each recurring event to expand instances within the visible range.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

ColumnHeader.data-today: Present when the date represents today
ColumnHeader.data-weekend: Present when is a weekend day

DayCell.data-today: Present when the date represents today
DayCell.data-weekend: Present when is a weekend day

Event.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state
